summary.intent: Rename GitHub Actions workflow files to match a naming convention update that was part of PR #464.
summary.outcome: The workflow files were renamed and the changes were committed and pushed, completing the PR update.

repo: GitHub Actions workflow files live in .github/workflows/ and follow a naming convention that should stay consistent with the features they support (e.g., desktop-release, desktop-staging-release).

code.finding: File was renamed as part of a broader PR update.

workflow: When renaming related artifacts (e.g., code + config files), workflow files like GitHub Actions YAMLs are easy to overlook and should be included in the same rename pass.

friction: The workflow file rename was initially missed when updating PR #464, requiring a follow-up step after the user pointed it out.
